rationale: C104 flagged rows because fair_value was stored as 0. Raw SOI rows show the corresponding fair-value cells as dashes, including multiple debt rows and equity/common-unit rows. A dash in these schedule fair-value cells represents a nil value, so normalization to 0 is source-consistent rather than a data error. The issue is rule scope: zero fair value can be legitimate and should not be treated as an extraction defect when it is directly present as a dash in the filing.
